title: Dungeon Loot Configurator
description: Adds datapack-driven loot-table integrations that allows loot -tables to add things into other loot-tables
body:
Adds datapack-driven loot-table integrations.

This mod keeps compatibility with the mod "Loot Integrations", so datapacks built for that mod should work here as well.

## Details

- Loads loot modifier JSON from `data/<namespace>/loot/*.json`.
- Samples extra loot from source tables and appends it to target chest loot.
- Can skip map items and ignored tagged items.
- Can trim generated results so chest loot does not overflow.

## Config

The config is written to `config/dungeonlootconfigurator.json`.
